title: CabinetOS update
description:
`latest.json`: the newest version of one channel, where its zip is, how
to check it, and where its release notes are.

channel.description: The channel this file belongs to.

notes.description: The release notes: the CHANGELOG section of the version.

requires.description: The runtimes the version needs, `major.minor`, for the user to see.

schemaVersion.description: The format of this file; always 1 for now.

version.description:
The version, as semantic versioning writes it: `0.2.0`, or with a
pre-release tag on the preview channel, `0.2.0-preview.1`.

UpdateChannel.description:
A release channel: which `latest.json` the updater reads
(`<update.source>/<channel>/latest.json`).

oneOf.description: Releases only; never a version with a pre-release tag.

url.description:
A Markdown file: an absolute URL, or a path relative to
`latest.json`.

windowsAppRuntime.description: The Windows App Runtime, `major.minor`, such as `2.5`.

UpdateZip.description: Where a release's zip is and how to check it.

sha256.description:
The zip's SHA-256, 64 hex digits. A download with another hash is
deleted.

size.description:
The zip's size in bytes, more than 0. A download that grows beyond
it is stopped and deleted.

url.description:
An absolute URL (the GitHub Release asset), or a path relative to
`latest.json`.
